name: Integrated production dual-hash WASM bounded speed diagnostic

reproductionRunner.boundary: The runner preserves the measurement logic but was tracked after the diagnostic execution; this is reproducible intermediate evidence, not a pre-run registration.

aggregateDisclosure.environmentalDrift: The first measured baseline block took 33.005 seconds while the other five baseline blocks took 29.018 to 29.257 seconds.
aggregateDisclosure.effect: The unfiltered aggregate makes final look 1.749% faster and is not used as the central estimate.
aggregateDisclosure.decisionStatistic: The robust pair median indicates about 0.311% lower normalized throughput. The five descriptively stable pairs range from about 0.952% lower to 0.066% lower.
aggregateDisclosure.exclusionRule: No block was removed. The stable range is explicitly post-run descriptive rather than preregistered.

referenceThresholdDecision.meaning: No gross direct-WASM performance regression was observed for the final exact binary.

limitations: This is a fixed-depth speed diagnostic, not a playing-strength metric.
The browser worker, JavaScript host, shared transposition table, opening book, and concurrent browser load were not measured.
The tracked reproduction runner was added after execution, so the result has no preregistered promotion authority.
One system-load excursion affected the first measured baseline block; every raw block remains disclosed.

The final binary performs about 0.988% less search work on this holdout because the corrected dual identity changes collision handling, so normalized throughput is more informative than wall time alone.

claimBoundary.supported: The integrated 36,545-byte production WASM showed approximately 0.3% lower robust-median normalized throughput, a conservative measured-block floor near 0.95% lower, zero WASM-memory delta, and no gross direct-WASM speed regression on this bounded holdout.
notSupported: The dual-hash change made the engine stronger or gained Elo.
The engine reached stable high-dan strength.
The complete browser/shared-TT path has identical performance.
This diagnostic alone authorizes merge, deployment, or a live change.
